        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]

        aapl_bar = data.Bars[aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(aapl) else None

        previous_spy_close = self.spy_previous_close
        previous_spy_sma = self.spy_previous_sma

            self.spy_previous_close = spy_bar.Close
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

                else:

            return

            return

        spy_crossed_above = (

            and previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma

            and previous_spy_sma is not None
            and previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma

            self.MarketOrder(spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)

            self.strategy_b_shares > 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60

        relative_strength = self.rsi_average_gain / self.rsi_average_loss

        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        # 101 closes are retained so both today's and yesterday's 100-day
        # simple moving averages can be compared on the same daily bar.
        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=101)
        self.aapl_closes = deque(maxlen=4)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        # Each strategy accounts for only its own private lot.
        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0
        self.pending_orders = {}
        self.spy_order_pending = False
        self.aapl_order_pending = False

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = data.Bars

        # Market-state quantities continue to consume every available bar,
        # even when another subscribed ticker is absent that day.
        if bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.spy_closes.append(float(bars[self.spy].Close))
        if bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]
            self.aapl_closes.append(float(aapl_bar.Close))
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        # A missing daily bar for any subscription suppresses every rule.
        if any(not bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        # No strategy can trade until every required indicator/window is ready.
        if (len(self.spy_closes) < 101 or len(self.aapl_closes) < 4
                or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        spy_close = float(bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(bars[self.aapl].Close)

        spy_values = list(self.spy_closes)
        sma_today = sum(spy_values[-100:]) / 100.0
        sma_yesterday = sum(spy_values[-101:-1]) / 100.0
        spy_crossed_above = (spy_values[-2] <= sma_yesterday
                             and spy_close > sma_today)
        spy_crossed_below = (spy_values[-2] >= sma_yesterday
                             and spy_close < sma_today)

        aapl_values = list(self.aapl_closes)
        aapl_red_three = all(
            aapl_values[index] < aapl_values[index - 1]
            for index in range(1, 4)
        )

        # Evaluate every sell before evaluating any buy.
        if self.spy_lot > 0 and not self.spy_order_pending and spy_crossed_below:
            self._submit_lot_order(self.spy, -self.spy_lot, "spy", "Strategy A sell")

                and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60):
            self._submit_lot_order(
                self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot, "aapl", "Strategy B sell"
            )

            quantity = floor(0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:

                if quantity > 0:

                        self.aapl, quantity, "aapl", "Strategy B buy"
                    )

        ticket = self.MarketOrder(symbol, quantity, False, tag)
        self.pending_orders[ticket.OrderId] = strategy
        if strategy == "spy":
            self.spy_order_pending = True
        else:
            self.aapl_order_pending = True

        strategy = self.pending_orders.get(order_event.OrderId)

            return

        fill_quantity = int(order_event.FillQuantity)
        if strategy == "spy":

        else:

            del self.pending_orders[order_event.OrderId]
            if strategy == "spy":

            else:
